doc: Hedge-fund-grade quality gates. v2 replaces broken elite_score with ml_score. Per-asset thresholds derived from 3,500+ row closed ledger analysis (2026-05-02).
_changelog: v2 (2026-05-02): BREAKING — removed min_elite_score (negative -0.17 correlation with profitability)
v2 (2026-05-02): ADDED min_ml_score threshold (0.82) — optimal precision-recall from ROC analysis
v2 (2026-05-02): ADDED per-asset-class override block for score floors
v2 (2026-05-02): CHANGED min_risk_reward 0.8 -> 1.25 (captures 85% of profitable sub-1.5 trades)
v2 (2026-05-02): CHANGED max_risk_reward 2.0 -> 3.0 (allows high-conviction asymmetric setups)
v2 (2026-05-02): REMOVED WINNER_FILTER confidence > 0.85 block (0% accuracy, blocked only winners)
v1 (legacy): min_elite_score: 80 -> reduced to 30 (2026-04) -> REMOVED in v2
note_production_status: Wiring status: hf_quality_gate.py::hf_smart_pick_post_score_reason was identified ORPHAN-CONSUMED on 2026-05-02 (issue #685). PR #660 lands the threshold update; a follow-up wiring PR is required to make passes_hedge_fund_gate() in alpha_engine/hedge_fund_quality_gate.py read this JSON. Until then, treat values here as the source-of-truth config; live gate behavior is governed by hard-coded constants in passes_hedge_fund_gate().
note_plan_v2_1_refutation: Historical: Foolproof Action Plan v2.1 (2026-05-02) claimed R:R 1.5-2.0 band yields PF 5.81. REFUTED (5-source consensus, issue #685): actual PF 1.258 on n=1244 for that band. Plan v2.1 also claimed ml_score>=0.90 = 66.7% accuracy on n=3: REFUTED — n=0 picks meet that threshold. v2 thresholds below derive from independent near_miss_analysis_2026_05_02.md, not from Plan v2.1.
_min_ml_score_evidence: ROC-AUC optimal threshold. ml_score >= 0.82: F1=0.68, Precision=0.71, Recall=0.65. Outperforms elite_score across all metrics. Source: near_miss_analysis_2026_05_02.md
_min_rr_evidence: R:R 1.25-1.5 range: 51.2% WR, profitable. R:R < 1.0: toxic. 1.25 captures 85% of profitable sub-1.5 trades while blocking toxicity. Source: shadow_blocked.json analysis (n=500)
_max_rr_evidence: S-Tier crypto shows R:R 2.0-3.0 produces highest PF. Cap at 3.0 prevents never-hit-TP scenarios while allowing asymmetric payoffs.
_score_floor_evidence: Derived from gate_optimization_2026_05_02.md. Floors calibrated to maximize PF per asset class while maintaining minimum pick flow (n>=20/week).
_fwd_wr_evidence: FOREX lowered to 0.50 (trusted filter shows 48.7% true WR). BOND/ETF at 0.50-0.55 for accumulation. CRYPTO at 0.60 for quality bar.

CRYPTO_C_TIER.reason: PF 0.36, -46.59% realized PnL, 68.5% loser rate. Suspend pending >6 months T3 proof-of-life in paper trading.

winner_filter._abolished_reason: WINNER_FILTER (confidence > 0.85 -> reject) had 0% accuracy. The 0.85-0.90 confidence zone is the SWEET SPOT with 82% WR / PF 11.8. This filter blocked ONLY winners. Never re-enable without full revalidation.
